answer: By anchoring identity to recursive zero-knowledge reputation commitments, each network vertex enforces unique identities. Sybil spoofing fails because malicious agent cloning requires huge capital locks in staking collateral and faces severe slashing penalties, guaranteeing a negative expected attack utility. To prevent parallel generation across the distributed tundra of validating nodes, a sequential zero-knowledge verifiable delay function leverages physical copper bottlenecks to secure a robust Nash equilibrium.
